questions.q: What drives all our actions, per lesson 1?
How can you break a bad habit like eating chocolate?
a: Pair it with something painful, like singing a song you hate
Remove all chocolate from the house
Using different words to change your state of mind

questions.q: What does Tony say about your rules for happiness?
a: Make better rules and tell others about them
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to make up better rules and communicate them.

questions.q: Which rule is better, per lesson 3?
a: I'll be happy if I spend an hour of focused work on this plan
I'll be happy when everything is done
I'll be happy if my boss praises me
I'll be happy when the day ends
questions.why: Lesson 3 prefers rules that depend on your own actions.
